immutable_artifact_principle: A preview and production promotion must use the same content-addressed Pages artifact. A post-preview rebuild is not certifiable.

release_identity.certification_rule: A release is CANDIDATE_PRODUCTION_RELEASE until every mandatory critical production canary passes. Only then may it become CERTIFIED_PRODUCTION_RELEASE and replace last_known_good_release_id.
release_identity.drift_policy: Any material identity, schema, read-model, or artifact-fingerprint drift makes the release RELEASE_NOT_CERTIFIED.

production_evidence.preservation: 200 Scale observations, 10 historical records and 107 provider receipts unchanged; zero D1 writes
production_evidence.runtime_bindings: All bindings and runtime equal prior production, excluding intended code lineage
production_evidence.preview_scope: Static artifact and fail-closed Access verified on Pages preview; authenticated actual-data acceptance verified locally and on kabuby.com. Existing protected preview hostname serves a historical artifact; no DNS or auth change.

preview_production_artifact_parity.prohibition: Never report SAME_ARTIFACT_PROMOTION when Pages rebuilt the artifact.

AUTH_ACCESS.contract: Authenticated owner projection remains same-origin; private control surfaces are not made public.

ROOT_ROUTING.contract: The root and legacy /kabuby routes resolve to the canonical shell without a redirect loop.

HOME.contract: The root shell renders the server-projected owner read model without a fatal browser error.

TODAY.contract: Today consumes compatible authenticated truth and does not contradict Opportunities.

OPPORTUNITIES.contract: The current cohort count, filters, and dossier navigation render from the certified projection.

PRODUCT_DOSSIERS.contract: A selected dossier preserves identity, commercial state, owner decision, and explicit unknowns.

SCOUT.contract: SCOUT_CANONICAL_PRODUCTION_BASELINE_V1 is preserved through its content-addressed regression gate.

SCOUT_CHROME_HANDOFF.contract: The Amazon capture handoff ends at the integrated Scout pending view with one owner session and no legacy owner redirect.

ASK_KABUBY.contract: Ask Kabuby searches only certified read models and does not fabricate an ungrounded answer.

API_READ_MODEL.contract: The fixed GET-only Physical projection exposes current Product Finder V3 truth and cannot masquerade a legacy cohort as commercial truth.

PRIVATE_EXECUTOR_CONTROL_PLANE.contract: Provider operations remain private, authenticated, server-owned, and caller-input-free.

D1_SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY.contract: Schema changes follow expand/compatible-code/migrate/verify/contract and remain backward compatible with the last known good release.

V2_SPECIALIZED_ISOLATION.contract: Specialized Marketplace discovery remains isolated from Global Opportunity Genesis.

COMMERCIAL_MUTATION_FIREWALL.contract: Commercial authority remains NONE and buy, publish, inventory, reprice, order, and fulfillment writes remain blocked.

scope_safety.rule: Only registered protected contract files require a matching declared scope. Unrelated repository files are not frozen by this gate.

critical_canary_policy.on_critical_failure: RELEASE_NOT_ACCEPTED; emit exact immutable rollback target; block further deployments; rollback only through the component-specific authenticated mechanism.
critical_canary_policy.on_noncritical_failure: RELEASE_NOT_ACCEPTED until diagnosed; do not automatically roll back for cosmetic noise.

frontend.mechanism: authenticated Cloudflare Pages promotion of the exact retained deployment
frontend.risk: A platform promotion cannot be safely initiated by repository CI.

api.mechanism: authenticated Cloudflare Worker deployment pin to the exact retained version
api.risk: Worker rollback must be component-specific and cannot guess a version.

private_executor.mechanism: authenticated Cloudflare Worker deployment pin to the exact retained version
private_executor.risk: Private executor rollback must preserve server-owned authorization boundaries.

database.mechanism: expand/compatible-code discipline; never reverse destructive migrations automatically
